# Page 2^page=2
• Launch: 2022 • Nodal Ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry • Guarantee Coverage: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) • Operating Agency: National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company Limited (NCGCTC) • Objectives o To provide guarantee upto a specified limit against credit instruments extended by Member Institutions (MIs) to finance eligible startups o Provide the collateral free debt funding to startups Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups (CGSS)

# Page 3^page=3
o Borrower ▪ Recognized by the DPIIT, and Certified by the MIs for guarantee cover ▪ Not in default to any lending/investing institution and not classified as Non- Performing Asset (NPA) as per guidelines of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) ▪ Reached stage of stable revenue stream, as assessed from audited monthly statements over a 12 months period, amenable to debt financing ▪ SEBI registered Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) o Member Institutions (MIs) ▪ Scheduled Commercial Banks and Financial Institutions ▪ RBI registered Non-Banking Finance Companies (NBFCs) • Having minimum networth of Rs.100 crores and credit rating of BBB and above as rated by external credit rating agencies accredited by RBI Eligibility

# Page 4^page=4
• Key Features o Maximum amount of debt (fund based or non-fund based facilities) eligible for guarantee cover is Rs. 20 crore per borrower, Irrespective of the amount of debt facilities extended o Extent of guarantee cover ▪ Transaction-based (for Banks/FIs/NBFCs) - up to Rs. 20 crores per borrower • 85% of the amount in default, for loan sanction amount upto Rs. 10 crores • 75% of the amount in default, for loan sanction amount exceeding Rs. 10 crore ▪ Umbrella-based (for SEBI registered AIFs) - maximum of Rs. 20 crores per borrower • Of actual losses or upto a maximum of 5% of Pooled Investment on which cover is being taken from the fund in Startups, whichever is lower

# Page 5^page=5
o Annual Guarantee Fee for startups in 27 Champion Sectors has been reduced to 1% p.a. from 2% p.a. o Complement the existing Schemes under Startup India initiative - Fund of Funds for Startups and Startup India Seed Fund Scheme o Existing loans covered under CGSS eligible for enhancement of credit facilities, but guarantee cover shall be restricted to maximum of Rs. 20 crore per borrower

# Page 7^page=7
Q. With reference to the Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups, which of the following statements is/are correct? 1. Maximum amount of debt eligible for guarantee cover is Rs. 20 crore per borrower. 2. All RBI registered Non-Banking Finance Companies (NBFCs) are eligible to lend the money. 3. Operating Agency under the scheme is National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company Limited (NCGCTC). Select the correct answer using the codes given below: [A] Only 1 and 2 [B] Only 2 and 3 [C] Only 1 and 3 [D] All of the above [E] None of the above
